about:
Missouri Medical Supply, Inc. was established in 1996 in St. Louis, Missouri, to provide high-quality home medical equipment and services that help individuals maintain independence and quality of life at home. The company operates from its location in St. Louis.

The firm supplies a range of home medical equipment and acts as an authorized Medicare provider and a contracted provider for numerous insurance companies. It handles Medicare claims processing and insurance billing for customers, serving healthcare facilities and home-care patients alike.

Its customer base includes hospitals, nursing homes, assisted living facilities, rehabilitation facilities, dialysis centers, and home care agencies across the region. The company focuses on the healthcare and home-healthcare sectors, providing equipment and services to both institutional and residential clients.

Missouri Medical Supply emphasizes a quick and easy Medicare claims process and offers state-of-the-art equipment for independent living. The business was founded to address the need for reliable home medical equipment and supportive services for those requiring assistance with daily living.
